name: Amazon Catalog Discovery
description: Engine for affiliate catalogs: grows a site's catalog from Amazon Creators searchItems. Each run imports seed ASINs (JSON files, read-only SQL on another DB), then walks the site's lane seeds x brands x price bands one itemPage at a time (breadth first, resumed across runs, never past itemPage 10, not stopped by a short page), classifies every new listing into the site's own lanes with title / browse-node rules, and inserts the in-lane ASINs within 40 calls and 300 new ASINs per run (configurable) and the consumer's budget share. Persists only the ASIN and our lane label; never an Amazon title, price or image. Every value comes from the site's config; per-site instances are config-only directories in the site repos.
